label: Real local loading/generation feasibility check on development tasks; not a pilot study or held-out evaluation

quantization.layer_policy: MLX-LM default: all modules exposing to_quantized with weight last dimension divisible by 64; includes tied embedding/output; norms and projection biases remain floating point

generation.reasoning: no separate reasoning mode in this checkpoint
generation.stop_policy: EOS IDs from pinned source generation_config.json; no extra stop strings
generation.template_policy: pinned source tokenizer, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False then encode(add_special_tokens=False); template supplies its default system message

budget.execution: local Apple M4 Max only; deployments loaded in separate processes
